item_short_desc: Rothco's Griplast Gloves feature a textured cowhide leather and cut & fire resistant fabric for maximum protection and durability.
description: Rothco's Fire Resistant Griplast Military Gloves feature a textured cowhide leather and cut & fire resistant fabric for maximum protection and durability. In addition these gloves feature textured leather palms, finger & thumb cradle provide extreme grip in any weather condition. For added protection the gloves feature padded leather knuckles and reinforced leather in high wear areas for added durability.
